corrections.method: Sampled the four approved mid-afternoon heroes (images/lakeview-hero.png, denver-hero.png, wilmette-hero.png, postcard-hero.png; 1672x941). Row elevation from the paint-overs' source camera (vFOV 50°, pitch down 3°). Sky pixels: b > r+40, b > g+10, b > 170, r+g+b > 420 (excludes blue windows). Bands: top 17-22° (frame top), mid 8-14°, horizon = the lowest 5 % of rows with visible sky (median 6.4°; below that houses and trees hide the sky). Clouds: near-white pixels above 3° (lit r+g+b > 705, shade otherwise). Per-image channel median, then the median across the four images (cloud lit from 2 images with enough lit pixels; mid from 3, Denver shows no sky at 8-14°). Every 3rd column, every 2nd row. No zenith is visible in any hero: the top-band colour is held from 20° to 90°.
corrections.reason: The pack's sky gradient (#73A5CC zenith, #A2C4DC at 30°, #DBDCD1 horizon) is paler and greyer than its own four hero paint-overs; built exactly, the engine sky read pale grey-blue (5A finding, 7 Oct).

corrections.method: Sampled the nine calibrated frames in frames/ (01-lakeview, 02-brooklyn, 03-midtown, 04-san-francisco, 05-alley, 05-train, 06-sloans, 07-new-orleans, 08-miami). Sky pixels: b > r+25, b > g, b > 150, rows in the top 55 % of each frame; each frame's sky extent split into thirds; per-frame band median, then the median across frames: top third #7AAFE2 and middle third #8FBAE7 (9 frames each). Horizon: only the three frames whose sky reaches an unobstructed horizon (01 lakeview #A0CCF2, 02 brooklyn #94C7FA, 07 new-orleans #A2C8ED) give the per-channel median #A0C8F2; the other frames' lowest sky band is cut by buildings and haze and is excluded.
corrections.reason: The pack's sharedLook sky (#73A5CC zenith, #A2C4DC mid, #DBDCD1 horizon) is the pale house-contrast-v1 JSON that R corrected from that pack's heroes; the pack's own calibrated frames show the clear blue sky, so the frames win.

precedence.statement: street-geometry-rules-v1 owns street geometry (carriageway, lane, sidewalk widths by country and class); the infrastructure kit owns look (markings, materials, colours, bridge, rail and airport styling). Keys marked supersededFor=geometry are not geometry sources. Images beat JSON applies to look, not measurements.

road-signs-signals-v1 governs signs and signals everywhere and all road markings outside the US; infrastructure-kit-v1 governs US lane markings and crosswalks. Keys marked supersededFor=us-markings are not sources for US markings; keys marked governs=us-markings are. Keys marked supersededFor=signs-signals (country style packs' own signal rules) are not sources either.

lake-winter-v1 and style-b-calibration-v2 own water colour (Lake Michigan stays the #315F7F family); water-surfaces-v1 is approved for mechanics only: wave terms, foam, shore types, ice gating, live inputs and budget. Its colour, reflection/roughness, exposure and ice colour keys are not compiled; lake-winter-v1 wave tables carry supersededFor=wave-mechanics.

chicago-denver-life-v1, nyc-life-v1, sf-life-v1 and seasonal-holiday-life-v1: content approved, look owned by style-b-calibration-v2. Life rules are binding: one actor pool, and events (game-day crowds, festival tents, opened hydrants, markets, plows, seasonal sellers and the like) stay OFF unless a verified schedule, event or history, or a labelled demo, enables them (every seasonal-holiday-life-v1 scene is gated this way). Counts are per 100 m of one side (Chicago-Denver, SF), per 150 m (NYC) and a percent of residential building frontages (seasonal-holiday-life-v1): one unit is needed before the pools merge. Their copied lighting blocks, material roughness, water roughness, detail tiers and face policies are not compiled (calibration v2 and the lake pack own them).

nyc-hero-v1 light states and the weather-moments-v1 New York pairs were approved together and disagree: winter low sun 15 deg / 155 deg against 8 deg / 225 deg, snow-day direct light 0 against 0.08, rainy-night wet-road roughness 0.2-0.35 against asphalt 0.52 with patch-only reflections. No precedence is set; both are compiled under their own prefixes.

weather-moments-v1 repeats the daytime master's exposure on every endpoint (relativeEV +0.35, fog and golden hour included) where night-fog-v1's morning fog is +0.10. Those exposure keys are not compiled (the daytime master and night-fog-v1 own exposure); which value wins for fog and overcast is unclear and goes to R.

mountain-terrain-v1 aspen and conifer colours differ from foliage-seasons-v1, its snow differs from lake-winter-v1, and its palettes are keyed by calendar season where foliage-seasons-v1 turns the calendar switch off. No precedence is set; all are compiled under their own prefixes. Its slope rules are a copy of terrain-slope-v1 and are not compiled. R's 8 Oct approvals list names mountains, so the r2 fixes and the hiking trails are treated as approved.
